title: SQS not-found, awsQueryCompatible, header present
why: The awsQueryCompatible case as AWS answers it: the JSON body names the modeled shape and the x-amzn-query-error header carries the legacy Query code with a fault suffix. Nothing but the header states the Query code, so an interpreter that ignores it cannot match a clause that names only that spelling.

body.message: The specified queue does not exist.

expect.name: a clause naming the modeled shape
a clause naming only the Query code
a near miss on the shape
